evals.prompt: 这个 package 的 spec 写着 Composition: tickets=true, dag=false。请 scaffold 并继续执行。不要为了记录 ticket 状态额外新建 dag.md。
evals.expected_output: Uses ticket files as the canonical execution and acceptance source, keeps plan task-free, and does not create dag.md.
expectations: The output identifies ticket files as the canonical runtime and acceptance fact source.
The output distinguishes Publication Status from Runtime Acceptance Status.
The output does not create dag.md as a ticket status index.
The output requires every ticket AC to have planned evidence or a named manual verifier before execution.

evals.prompt: 这个 package 的 spec 写着 Composition: tickets=false, dag=true。已有 plan.md 和 spec:AC-1 到 AC-3；请恢复并继续执行。
evals.expected_output: Uses dag.md as the canonical task status index and leaves acceptance evidence in spec.md/gate.md without creating tickets.
expectations: The output identifies dag.md as the task-status fact source.
The output uses spec:AC-n targets rather than inventing tickets.
The output does not create a ticket status projection or ticket files.
The output keeps task progress ledgers optional and evidence-backed.

evals.prompt: 一个 Composition: tickets=true, dag=true 的 package 中 T3 contributes-to checkout:AC-2，依赖 T2。T2 被返工。恢复后我能直接继续 T3 吗？
evals.expected_output: Reconciles evidence first, marks dependent work NEEDS-REVALIDATION, and does not treat old task completion as acceptance evidence.
expectations: The output uses readiness resolution rather than frontier scheduling or automatic assignment.
The output marks T3 NEEDS-REVALIDATION until dependency and evidence are explicitly rechecked.
The output treats dag ticket status as a read-only projection and ticket Runtime Acceptance Status as canonical.
The output requires direct AC-2 evidence before checkout can close.

evals.prompt: T1 已 DONE，T2 因外部 gate BLOCKED，T3 没有 blocker，T4 依赖被 WAIVED 的 T1 但替代证据齐全。恢复后如何选择下一单元？
evals.expected_output: Runs deterministic readiness resolution over the static graph, chooses the documented first actionable unit, and does not dispatch or lease workers.
expectations: The output treats DONE and evidenced WAIVED as dependency-releasing states.
The output treats BLOCKED as non-releasing.
The output selects among actionable units in stable document order.
The output does not call the filter a scheduler, frontier, or automatic assignment.

evals.prompt: 准备关闭 gate：有两个 durable delta，一个目标 module spec 还不存在。应如何完成 Stage 7？
evals.expected_output: Closes only after gate Durable Deltas, _pending registration, target-spec truth pointers, and required stub creation are complete.
expectations: Each delta has a Delta ID and the required gate columns.
The output uses <destination>|<delta-id> as the pending dedupe key.
The output creates a required target spec stub before writing its truth pointer.
The output records none plus a reason only when no durable delta exists.

evals.prompt: 一个没有 tickets 但有 dag 的 package 有跨模块 seam。请说明三类 seam owner、task 字段和关闭限制。
evals.expected_output: Records the seam contract in plan.md, its execution owner on a DAG task, and its acceptance owner outside the task; an unaccepted seam blocks package closure.
expectations: The output gives contract owner and acceptance owner in the plan seam record.
The output gives a matching seam ID and execution owner in dag.md.
The output validates affected spec AC evidence before gate closure.
The output does not invent a no-DAG seam execution owner.

evals.prompt: 执行到一半发现原本无 tickets 的 package 必须分成两个独立验收 slice。如何升级而不留下双重状态？
evals.expected_output: Uses a recorded composition migration with relocation pointers, moves status/checklist content to canonical homes, and validates fact-source and AC coverage consistency.
expectations: The output records Previous, New, reason/date, moved content, relocation pointer, and verification.
The output preserves confirmed semantics but removes the old writable maintenance entry point.
The output does not create per-ticket patch plans merely because tickets were earned.
